note: The ringed giant from the port's sky, made real: a gas_ball, a real ball of gas 3.5 km in radius (its type's surface) that you fly round, with a town floating on a deck on top (deck, keel, glass enclosure, gate shield, landing bays). Fly within its handoff of the cloud tops and its scene takes over with no fade, like Grit Station; go down into the clouds and the ship is lost. It hangs exactly where the sky painting was (azimuth 26, elevation 17 from the port: 'at' is that direction, 30 km out), so it looks as big as the painting did; it is smaller than the painting made it look, so the flight is short. replaces_sky_painting turns the painted giant off wherever this real one is drawn and on the planet itself. body: its look from space and its own sky (banded like the painting, with its ring; inner and outer in planet radii). The space station (content/core/stations/orbital_station.json, PR #501) hangs right over the top of the ball where the deck town was: it is the place you go (Z docks you in its round bay). The deck under it is a size-1 town kept only because every planet still needs a town: where you spawn when a save loads here, where a crashed ship is towed and where you wake after falling off.

landmarks.note: The station (moved here from the moon, PR #501) over the top of the giant, 200 m above the deck's level: the market floor and the bay's deck are 200 m up, its spires well clear of the small landing deck below. Inside the giant's own scene (its handoff reaches 2600 m above the clouds).
